methods.description: Write fractions from equal parts/marked totals and compare same denominators.
Subdivide equal-area models or use equivalent fractions with related denominators; meaningful equality included.
Compare available whole parts in the specified denominator; equality does not satisfy greater.
Use marked and total counts, not marked counts alone, for differently sized collections.
Divide a collection into denominator equal groups and mark numerator groups; record equivalent names.
Explain that raw shaded areas compare fractions only on equal-sized wholes.
